question: Calculate the total income from Meat Lovers pizzas priced at $12 and Vegetarian pizzas at $10. Include any extra toppings charged at $1 each. Ensure that canceled orders are filtered out. How much money has Pizza Runner earned in total?
sql:
WITH distinct_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
order_details AS (
    SELECT 
        d.order_id,
        d.pizza_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        d.extras,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.extras IS NULL OR d.extras = '' THEN 0
            ELSE (LENGTH(d.extras) - LENGTH(REPLACE(d.extras, ',', ''))) + 1
        END AS extra_count,
        pcr.cancellation
    FROM distinct_orders d
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON d.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders pcr ON d.order_id = pcr.order_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 12
            WHEN pizza_name = 'Vegetarian' THEN 10
            ELSE 0
        END + extra_count
    ) AS total_income
FROM order_details
WHERE cancellation IS NULL OR cancellation = ''
  AND pizza_name IN ('Meatlovers', 'Vegetarian')
